title: Frequent Block Picker
description: Quickly pick your recently used and most frequently selected building blocks from a movable creative inventory panel
body:
## What is Frequent Block Picker?

Frequent Block Picker is a client-side mod that helps you quickly access the blocks you use most often while building in Creative mode.

It adds a small movable panel to the creative inventory screen, showing blocks you recently selected and blocks you frequently use. This makes it easier to keep building without repeatedly searching through the creative inventory.

## Features

- Shows recently selected blocks in a `Recent` section
- Shows frequently selected blocks in a `Frequent` section
- Tracks block selections, not block placements
- Lets you pick up one item from the panel and place it into your inventory
- Movable panel position
- Adjustable rows and columns from the panel toolbar
- Designed to sit alongside REI-style item panels
- Client-side only

## How Frequent Ranking Works

The frequent list is based on how often you select a block.

For example, if you often pick stone, glass, or oak planks while building, those blocks will rise in the frequent list. The mod does not count how many blocks you place in the world. It only tracks which building blocks you select while working in Creative mode.

## Why Use It?

Creative builders often reuse the same set of blocks during a build. Frequent Block Picker keeps those blocks close at hand, so you can spend less time searching and more time building.
